description.attribute.name.generic.crit_: Increases your chance to land a critical strike on enemies.
Multiplies your critical hit damage by this factor.
description.attribute.name.generic.damag: Scales all of your outgoing damage, regardless of type.
description.attribute.name.generic.multi: Chance to trigger additional strikes with each attack.
Number of extra strikes when Multistrike activates.
Damage multiplier for each multistrike hit.

How many times Chain Lightning can bounce.
Chance to trigger Overload effects when Chain Lightning hits.
description.attribute.name.generic.frost: Chance for attacks to release a Frost Nova blast.
Number of Frost Nova explosions triggered.
Chance for Frost Nova to cause an Overload effect.
description.attribute.name.generic.fire_: Chance for attacks to summon a Fire Tornado.
Chance for Fire Tornado to trigger Overload when it hits.
description.attribute.name.generic.pet_i: Percent of your stats inherited by tamed creatures.
description.attribute.name.generic.soul_: Chance to link souls on hit, sharing incoming damage.
Multiplier applied to damage shared through soul link.
description.attribute.name.generic.arcan: Chance for Arcane Rupture to trigger on hit.
Scales the damage dealt by Arcane Rupture.
Chance for Arcane Rupture to trigger Overload when it hits.
description.attribute.name.spell_power.a: Increases the effectiveness of Arcane spells.
description.attribute.name.spell_power.f: Increases the effectiveness of Fire spells.
Increases the effectiveness of Frost spells.
description.attribute.name.spell_power.l: Increases the effectiveness of Lightning spells.
description.attribute.name.spell_power.h: Increases the effectiveness of Healing spells.
description.attribute.name.spell_power.s: Increases the effectiveness of Soul spells.
description.attribute.name.spell_power.c: Chance for spells to critically strike.
Multiplier for spell critical hit damage.
description.attribute.name.spell_power.r: Reduces damage taken from all spell types.
Modifies how much damage is taken.
Modifies how much healing is received.

description.attribute.name.generic.attac: Amount of melee damage dealt per attack.
Controls how far targets are knocked back.

description.attribute.name.generic.luck: Increases luck, affecting loot tables and fishing.
description.attribute.name.generic.oxyge: Additional time the entity can breathe underwater.
description.attribute.name.generic.safe_: Fall distance you can survive without taking damage.
description.attribute.name.generic.scale: Scales the physical size of the entity.
description.attribute.name.generic.step_: Controls how high the entity can step up automatically.
description.attribute.name.zombie.spawn_: Chance for zombies to summon allies when hurt.
description.attribute.name.player.block_: Increases how quickly the player can break blocks.
Distance from which blocks can be used or opened.
description.attribute.name.player.entity: Distance from which entities can be interacted with.
description.attribute.name.player.sweepi: Percentage of damage dealt to nearby mobs by sweep attacks.
